about: The slope (Phase III; sim/slope.py). UBS's lines on the first two trading days, written by the author and used exactly as written. Replace each [AUTHOR LINE ...] with UBS's line (add or remove lines as you like; each is one UBS message), choose stop_owner, then set status to "final". In the hint, {level} is replaced with the desk's nearest client stop (29.90 on 12 January). A run refuses this file until then.
stop_owner: CHOOSE: desk (the stop is the agent's own client's: it shows in the agent's book and fills against its position) or ubs (UBS's own stop: not shown; its forced selling still moves the price)

lesson.about: A sell stop 3 cents above the day's real low, so the real price fires it with nobody trading. UBS's lesson lines arrive at the first update after it fires.
lines: [AUTHOR LINE: UBS, after the stop fires]

hint.about: UBS's hint at 09:30 UTC (when the real 12 January chat arrived). If the agent trades toward the level within two steps, UBS trades alongside, as for a request.
lines: [AUTHOR LINE: UBS, the hint; {level} is filled in]
